items.name: MTU Calculator
items.description: Calculates optimal MTU and MSS values for different network types (Ethernet, PPPoE, VPN, IPv6 tunnels) based on overhead bytes.
items.whyValuable: Network admins and gamers troubleshoot latency and fragmentation issues by finding the right MTU size, a recurring technical need with no simple existing calculator in the catalogue.

items.name: CSR Generator
items.description: Generates a Certificate Signing Request and matching private key (RSA/ECDSA) entirely in-browser for SSL certificate applications.
items.whyValuable: Developers and sysadmins regularly need CSRs for SSL setup and currently rely on OpenSSL CLI or third-party servers, so a trustworthy client-side generator fills a real, recurring technical gap.

items.name: Fiscal Quarter Calculator
items.description: Converts any calendar date into its fiscal quarter and week based on a custom fiscal year start month.
items.whyValuable: Finance and accounting teams frequently need to map dates to non-standard fiscal calendars, and this durable business utility is missing from the calendar category.

items.name: Scatter Plot Maker
items.description: Creates a downloadable scatter plot with optional trendline from pasted or CSV-uploaded X/Y data.
items.whyValuable: Scatter plots are one of the most common chart types for showing correlation, and the charts category currently lacks this fundamental visualization while offering 6 other chart types.

items.name: Paper Size Converter
items.description: Converts between international paper sizes (A-series, B-series, Letter, Legal, Tabloid) with dimensions in mm, cm, and inches.
items.whyValuable: Anyone printing, designing, or shipping documents internationally regularly needs to reconcile ISO vs US paper standards, a simple but high-frequency lookup missing from the size category.

items.name: Audio Waveform Generator
items.description: Renders a visual waveform image or SVG from an uploaded audio file using the Web Audio API, with customizable colors and export options.
items.whyValuable: Podcasters and musicians need waveform visuals for thumbnails, video backgrounds, and album art, and this is a distinct visual-output need not covered by the existing audio inspection tools.

items.name: Circle of Fifths Generator
items.description: Interactive circle of fifths diagram showing key signatures, relative minors, and chord relationships for any selected key.
items.whyValuable: It's one of the most searched-for music theory reference tools among musicians and students, and the existing music category lacks any key-relationship visualization despite having key-signature and chord-scale tools.

items.name: Mortgage Refinance Calculator
items.description: Compares your current mortgage to a new refinance offer, calculating monthly savings, break-even point, and total interest difference.
items.whyValuable: Refinancing decisions are high-stakes and searched constantly during rate-change cycles, and this is distinct from the existing generic mortgage-calculator which doesn't handle comparison/break-even scenarios.
